items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Mac's place and he took $25 and you have to pay his debt.

ctx.x: Mac's place and he took $25 and you have to pay his debt." I died! You see, Milt, in those days when you joined the band nobody told you nothing. When you took another man's place, you were him, and if he owed anything, fine. But what had happened, I didn't know. I had left them and they took a job for a week, a place called - oh, I don't know the name now. Jimmy Rushing wouldn't draw any money because he's going to get his money at the end of the week. But Chick the guitar player Jake and the saxophone player…
Hey, who was in that band? The reeds was who? Was it Lester and -
